regions.text: いつたい日生活にあって偶然と云はれるものの大部分はこの目々積極餡偶然である。

quote.translation: In general, the greater part of what is called chance in everyday life is this positive teleological contingency.

regions.text: 二三の例を最げて置かう。

quote.translation: Let me give two or three examples.

regions.text: 「十二月の十五日に側然にも東鶏冠山北堡壘で敵の陸正面防鐶司合官の、エンドラランョ少將が酸死した。

quote.translation: "On the fifteenth of December, by chance, Major-General Kondratenko, the enemy's commander of the land-front defence, was killed in action at the North Fort of East Jiguanshan.

regions.text: コンドスランョ少將はたたに要塞防禦歌術において優秀なばかりでなく非常に信望があつたらしくョンドラテンョがやつてあるから守備兵は安心して戦ふことが出來るとい

quote.translation: Kondratenko was, it seems, not only excellent in the tactics of fortress defence but also enjoyed very great trust, and it had long been rumoured that because Kondratenko was in charge the garrison could fight with confidence.

regions.text: 象風に前から噂がありましたが、その少將が十二月の十五日に東鶏冠山北堡疊に水てゐるかるないか知らなかつたが我がニヤ入サンチの弾が、働然にもそこに中つてやられてしまつたのです』（大阪初日新聞、昭和十年三厚四日）。

quote.translation: We did not know whether or not he had come to the North Fort of East Jiguanshan on the fifteenth of December, but our twenty-eight-centimetre shell by chance struck there and he was killed" (Ōsaka Asahi Shinbun, 4 March 1935).

regions.text: つてやられてしまつたのです』（大阪初日新聞、昭和十年三厚四日）。我が地琿は敵を撃

quote.translation: Our shells had the purpose of striking the enemy, but they did not take Major-General Kondratenko in particular as their target.

regions.text: 我が地琿は敵を撃つことを目的としてゐたが特にュンドラテンコ少將を目標としたわけではなく砲弾が東鶏冠山北堡愛に向つて發射されたことと、同少將がその日に

quote.translation: That the shell was fired towards the North Fort of East Jiguanshan and that the major-general came to that fort on that day are two independent series, and this is why his death in action is called chance.

regions.text: その堡壘に來たこととは獨立した二つの系列であるから、同少將の戦死を偶然といふのである。また「昭和電力社長増田次郎氏は二十六日午前東京地方裁剝所に召喚され金澤檢事の長時間にわたる取調べを受けたのち更に山口豫審判事の拘留訊問を受けたが午後六時に至り渡職罪として起訴前の

quote.translation: A second example: "Mr Masuda Jirō, president of Shōwa Electric Power, was summoned to the Tokyo District Court on the morning of the twenty-sixth and, after a lengthy examination by Prosecutor Kanazawa, was further subjected to detention questioning by Preliminary Judge Yamaguchi, and at six in the afternoon, on a charge of official corruption, he was committed to Ichigaya Prison under compulsory measures prior to indictment.
